notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Keyboard and Mouse controls are now available; if you don't start with a controller connected it is enabled automatically, and can be toggled in the Character Select screen otherwise.

DEFAULT KEYBOARD AND MOUSE CONTROLS:
WSAD or Arrow Keys: Movement
Mouse: Aim
Left-Click: Shoot
Right-Click: Manuever
Q: Ultimate
L-Shift: Slide
E: Pickup
F: Drop Weapon (if not default)

These controls are rebindable in Character Select and in the Settings menu.

Added additional character lines when gaining enough meter to use their Ultimate.

Reduced the load time for accessing the Gallery and Settings from the Main Menu.

If you have a profile name set from Character Select, your in-game HUD shows your profile's name instead of P1, P2, etc.

Minor HUD/UI fixes.

We've heard your requests; Online being is still being investigated, and stay tuned for an update regarding Solo play modes

notes.title: Super Knockoff! VS - OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're happy to finally release Super Knockoff! VS! Thanks to your support and the wonderful developers at Action Panel, we've been able to bring this crazy platform shooter to life. We hope you enjoy the antics, and we'd love to play with you all at our convention appearances! If you play with friends and record it, we'd love to see it! Please send it our way via Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/superknockoffvs 

As this is our first release, bugs may pop up. If you happen to find any, please leave a post in the community and/or send a report to:
reports@superknockoffvs.com

Stay tuned for patches as we hope to squash what shows up post-release. 

Thank you so much for your support, and we hope to see your friendships ruined on the battlefield!

- Kirran
Producer, TFS Entertainment
